scenes.title: Inspect the equipment before returning it

captions.text: Open Roster on the deployment and find Demo radio kit under Equipment.
Read its Unit association and Issued column before changing the roster.
This exercise added the kit as a free-text equipment entry, and Issued is a dash.
At the right end of that row is the curved-arrow Return button.
Identify the intended item first, because the action belongs to
that specific equipment row.

scenes.title: Return the entry and verify the remaining roster

captions.text: Select the Return arrow for Demo radio kit.
The returned roster now says No equipment rostered.
The van is still present with call sign C S van one and a Crew count of one, and
Matthew Casey is still assigned to it.
Returning the equipment entry did not remove the unit or its person.
This action changes the deployment equipment assignment; no inventory
stock issue or stock return was performed for this free-text example.
Open Files to keep supporting material with this deployment.
The existing receipt already appears as a Receipt file.
In the upload row, keep Other as the type for the demonstration handover note.
Enter a recognizable Name, then use Choose File to select the prepared
fictional handover text file.
Review the type, name and selected file before choosing Upload.
Use the appropriate file category for the document you are actually retaining.
After Upload, verify the Saved message and the new row.
It shows the community support handover name, Other as its Type,
the text filename and the Added information for Kelly Severide.
The earlier Receipt remains as a separate row.
Check the filename as well as the display name so the record points
to the intended supporting file.
This is a fictional software exercise, and these attachments contain no
real incident or patient information.

scenes.title: Open and inspect the current manifest

captions.text: Select View manifest.
Resgrid opens an H T M L deployment manifest in a separate tab.
Read its deployment name, Planned status, agency references and window.
required_labels: TRAINING ONLY - Community support deployment · Planned

captions.text: Under Units, the van has call sign C S van one and one crew member.
Under Personnel, Casey is associated with that unit and has call sign C S one.
Seat and Certification are blank for this assignment.
Verify the actual people and assignments behind a summary count before using
the manifest for coordination.

scenes.title: Keep the handover useful across department types

captions.text: This same process helps departments hand over a clear picture of their assignment.
Community paramedicine and mental health response teams, search-and-rescue teams,
security departments, wildland contractors and industrial emergency teams can
retain their own supporting documents and review the current resources.
Fire and E M S departments use these same controls.
Keep the roster current, attach the right fictional or authorized
documentation, and check the manifest’s unit and personnel details
against the work being coordinated.
